summary.text:
Evaluate each.

V05: Candidate nearly identical to reference: same layout, thumbnails, main image, price, variants. Differences: breadcrumb spacing, "Select store" icon slightly different, chat bubble position, minor. Score 1.

V06: Reference shows modal with two media items visible, video play button overlay on right image, filter button bottom-left. Candidate shows 4 images grid, second image lacks play button overlay and hamburger filter button; modal structure, tabs, close button all present. Reference first row: product image left, lifestyle video right with play overlay. Candidate: same two images but no play button/filter icons, plus second row visible. Slight differences — maybe scroll position differs. Structure matches; minor icon differences. 0.75.

V07: Reference shows scrolled view with product image header at top, then tabs, then components grid showing 4 components visible, right large image. Candidate shows tabs at top (no header image strip), 6 components visible, right image. Criteria: horizontal tabs, six components, quantities, right big image. Candidate shows all six components; reference only shows 4 in view but criteria says six. Candidate layout matches well; reference has more top area (image + payment panel) because scrolled differently. Overall match high: 0.75 or 1. Differences: scroll position/state differs (reference shows top of section with main image). Candidate's card layout, typography match. I'd give 0.75 — different scroll offset making comparison partially different, but structure matches. Actually candidate shows more components which is good. The reference at this scroll state includes the image gallery strip at top; candidate doesn't. That's a difference in the visible state. 0.75.

V08: Nearly identical: STUBBARP legs, price $8.00/2 pack, quantity stepper, Add to bag. Minor differences: discount text "20% off" vs "19% off", heart icon position, minor spacing. Score 1? Content text difference (19 vs 20) is minor; layout matches. 1 seems fine, or 0.75 for text discrepancy. Anchors: 1 = 主要结构、比例、图片、层级和样式吻合. Text "19% vs 20%" is minor content, likely live data variation. Give 1.
